newsitem.title: USA: Northwestern Steel confirms plant closing.
newsitem.headline: Northwestern Steel confirms plant closing.

text.p: Northwestern Steel and Wire Co Wednesday said it will proceed with its plan to permanently close its rolling mill in Houston, Texas.
The company had said last month it was likely to close the unprofitable mill and said it expects to take a pretax, mostly non-cash, exit charge of $95-$105 million in the quarter ending July 31.
A study undertaken with the United Steelworkers of America did not result in an acceptable plan to restore profitability to the mill, Northwestern Steel said Wednesday.
Rolling operations ceased at the plant at the end of June and shipping from inventory is expected to be completed by mid-August, the company said.
Northwestern Steel shares were up 1/8 at 2-3/8 Wednesday.
